what: A thin 60px horizontal line drawn 20px before a small text link like ”About Us” or ”See more” slides 10px to the right (toward the text) in .2s linear on hover and returns over the same length on release — the text stays put and only the line moves closer. On phones (768px and below) it shrinks to a 45px line with a 10px gap and doesn’t move

options.--fx-gap: Gap between line and text (via style), default 20px
options.--fx-line-sp · --fx-gap-sp: Line length · gap at 768px and below, default 45px · 10px

note: The original swaps @keyframes moreLine/moreLineOff (.2s linear) on hover, so if you re-hover midway through the release, the original restarts from the 10px position, but this part uses a transition and continues from where it is

from.where: index.html ‹About Us› and ‹Back Number› .dm-btn-line (original .btnCircle::after — 60px line left -80px, hover translate3d(10px) .2s linear, 45px and no movement at 768px and below)
